title: How often should the sensor wake up?
intro: A temperature sensor runs on a 600 mAh lithium cell. Each time it wakes up it measures for 50 ms, sends one LoRa packet (40 mA while it transmits) and listens for 1 s for the acknowledgement (12 mA); in between it sleeps at 5 µA, and the cell also loses 2 % of its charge a month by itself. Choose the wake period: the battery must last at least a year, and the server must get at least 24 readings a day.
plotTitle: Battery charge over the first 30 days
checkLife: The battery lasts at least 365 days.
checkRate: The server gets at least 24 readings a day.
